display_name: Audit lifecycle IAM roles for a birther
description: Read-only inventory of the per-birther IAM lifecycle quartet's create-able members. Reports on each role's existence, trust policy hash, inline policy hash, attached managed policies, and tag set. Detects drift between the expected shape (per the plugin's pinned policy template versions) and live AWS state. Detects orphaned roles (e.g., <birther>-midwife exists but trust policy doesn't permit the birther's task role anymore). Returns the same per-step drift-detection fields that provision_lifecycle_roles(dry_run=true) would surface — operators have a clean 'audit then provision' workflow without duplicate state machines. ZERO IAM mutations of any kind. Plugin is herky-jerky-loaded — verb present in registry only during operator-initiated apply_manifest cycles.
embedding_description: Read-only audit of the IAM lifecycle quartet's create-able roles (midwife + undertaker) for a birther solet. Reports per-role existence / trust policy hash / inline policy hash / tag set / drift status. Use before provision_lifecycle_roles to confirm what would change.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: AdminResult envelope per ananta.interfaces.lifecycle_result_types.AdminResult: status (success when all probe calls completed regardless of role-existence outcomes; failed when AssumeRole or address-book resolution failed), birther_name (echo), idempotency_key='' (audit is read-only), dry_run=false, verb='audit_lifecycle_roles', steps (per-role audit; each entry has role / status (found / missing / drift_detected) / role_arn / policy_template_version_seen / trust_policy_hash / inline_policy_hash / managed_policies / tags), roles_provisioned=() (audit never provisions), policy_template_version='' (each role can carry a different version; per-step output records the per-role version), message (human-readable summary).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with the per-role status table — most operators run audit to confirm steady-state. When all roles report 'found' with no drift, surface a one-line OK summary. When ANY role reports 'missing' or 'drift_detected', surface that step's full detail (policy_template_version_seen vs expected; trust_policy_hash / inline_policy_hash mismatches) so the operator can decide whether to run provision_lifecycle_roles to reconcile.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Read-only IAM probe via the assumed <birther>-admin role; no mutations.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: AssumeRoleFailure: same as provision_lifecycle_roles — address-book or trust policy issue. AccessDenied on iam:GetRole / iam:ListRolePolicies / iam:GetRolePolicy / iam:ListRoleTags: the <birther>-admin role's inline policy is missing the Read verbs against ResourceTag/Pattern=<birther>-*. orphan_role_detected: a role exists with the expected name pattern but the trust policy fingerprint does not match the plugin's expected fingerprint — operator should reconcile via the AWS console.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: AssumeRoleFailure: fix the address-book entry or the role's trust policy. AccessDenied on Read verbs: the admin role's inline policy needs the Read surface; operator updates via AWS console (the admin can't self-rotate per chicken-and-egg). orphan_role_detected: AWS-console inspection of the role; either delete + provision_lifecycle_roles to recreate cleanly, or hand-edit the trust policy if the divergence is intentional.
